name: Honor Your Husband
overview: Scripture highlights the vital role of a virtuous woman who honors her husband, describing her as a crown to him and of great value beyond rubies, while warning against contentiousness that harms the marital relationship. The Proverbs passages emphasize the blessing and dignity a wife brings, and Galatians underscores the fruit of the Spirit, such as gentleness and love, which supports honoring one’s husband. Ephesians calls husbands to love their wives sacrificially, reflecting Christ’s love for the church, establishing a mutual, Christ-centered foundation for marriage.
